text:
Sam - Support: seeing a quick spike of 5xx/timeouts from hosted inference in eu-west around 12:05PT. multiple customer complains, some 502/504 and some client timeouts. attaching short logs.
Lin - CS: customer A reported 502s on batch embeddings and timed out after 10s. they said retries made it worse. ticket #C-4532
Maya - EngOncall: landing. can you paste the gateway traces and a sample request id?
Sam - Support: root ids: req=88a2, req=88a3, req=88b0. gateway shows `upstream timed out` and then 502.
Olivia - SRE: looking at k8s ingress tails, I see a burst of connections to inference-pool-eu with backend 504s; pod CPU spikes to 95% and goroutines climb.
Raj - Platform: any recent deploys to inference-pool-eu? deploy-bot: Deployment webapp to inference-pool-eu succeeded at 12:00PT (rev: f2c9).
Maya - EngOncall: not a code regression likely, could be packing/queue blowup. Sam, can you repro with the smallest payload? share curl.
Sam - Support:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \ 
 -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED\" \ 
 -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-1b\",\"inputs\":\"hello world\",\"max_tokens\":2048}'
```
Response: 504 after ~9.8s consistently when we blast 50 concurrent.
Olivia - SRE: I throttled new connections to pool for now and dropped burst to 30s. rolling restart of the overloaded pods started.
Maya - EngOncall: good. immediate mitigation: enable temporary autoscale bump + lower max_batch_time to 10ms for eu pool. Raj, can you apply policy?
Raj - Platform: applying autoscale bump + temp routing to fallback-small models. will monitor.
Lin - CS: notified affected customers with ETA ~25m for stabilization. logged follow-up with support playbook.
Maya - EngOncall: postmortem action items so far:
- investigate why KV cache didn't prevent repeated compute for identical prefixes (Olivia)
- add guardrails to reject >30 concurrent per-tenant default (Raj)
- refine batching parameters for tail latency under burst (Maya)
- add a synthetic load job to detect these patterns (Sam/QA)
Olivia - SRE: reopening pod profiling ticket and adding memory pressure alerts.
Sam - Support: customer A confirmed recovery at 12:28PT, error rate back to baseline.
Maya - EngOncall: closing incident thread for now. we'll follow up with a short postmortem doc and assign owners. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Autoscale policy applied to inference-pool-eu by Raj at 12:18PT.
